Replacing 3 m of 15 mm copper pipe matches the need to renew the faulty pipe that caused the water ingress.
Four 15 mm press fittings are consistent with connecting and securing the new 3 m pipe section.
Three hours of installer labor aligns with the tasks of detection, wall work, pipe replacement, and finishing.
Drying devices are needed to remove moisture from the 18 m² wall and 22 m² laminate floor described in the claim.
Three condensers for 14 days match the prolonged drying period required for the affected kitchen area.
Electricity consumption corresponds to operating the drying equipment used for the water‑damaged kitchen.
Moisture measurements are necessary to verify that the 18 m² wall and 22 m² floor have been properly dried.
